text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Man, talk about being a letdown... I
thought I
would win for sure this time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't blame Kitasan Black for being
upset about
her placement, considering
my own
disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can't possibly return the favor to
everyone who's
been cheering me on at
this rate...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: I'll make sure you win next time!
There's no time to mope around!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I'm so lucky to have you.
choice_data_list: Let's carry today's results into n...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Your encouragement's helped calm me
down a
bit, so thanks. I know I'll be fine
at my next race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're right. We can't afford to waste
any time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even if it seems like I'll be left in the
dust... No, it's exactly because I'll get
left in the dust that I
have to buckle
down and keep trying!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's firm resolution bolsters
my heart
as well.
